overall_safety_summary: One or more predefined rules were triggered.

hazards.rule_name: Bottle very close to oven or toaster
hazards.description: A detected bottle is very close to an oven or toaster.
hazards.explanation: The bottle may be knocked, heated or spilled while the nearby appliance is used.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Reduced grip strength or reaction speed may make a spill or hot container harder to manage.
hazards.recommended_action: Move the bottle to a stable area away from the appliance.

uncertainties: The baseline is limited to the fixed frozen ruleset and the available YOLO detections.
It cannot reason about heat, appliance state, hidden conditions or hazards outside its predefined rules.
